chapters/ch2.1:
And so Heesu got loaded into Oppa's car…
and arrived at a pay-to-fish sea pier.
chapters/ch2.2:
They say red snapper and monster rockfish bite here!
I got us a 12-hour pass~
chapters/ch2.4:
Then the bait bucket rattled…
and worms and live shrimp crawled out!
chapters/ch2.6:
Babe, grab the bait for me~
I'm going to save us a spot!
chapters/ch2.8:
The moment he sat down, Oppa only had eyes for his rod.
Heesu was boiling ramen on the burner…
chapters/ch2.9: So I'm just here to cook?
chapters/ch2.10:
Whenever we come fishing,
you don't care about me at all.
chapters/ch2.11: …Oh, a bite! I've got a bite!!
chapters/ch2.12: Just then, red snapper and striped beakfish leapt out of the sea!
chapters/ch2.14: Sunset. Oppa's cooler was still empty.
chapters/ch2.15: Ah… if only my gear were a little better….
chapters/ch2.17: Sell all your fishing gear. Right now.
chapters/ch2.19: Night fell, and Oppa started snoring in his chair…
chapters/ch2.21:
If you're just going to sleep at the pier,
don't come anymore. What a waste of money.
chapters/ch2.22: That instant— Oppa's rod bent like a bow!
chapters/ch2.25: …Where's the lantern. I'm going to save him.
chapters/ch2.26:
When the giant grouper fell, the sea grew calm.
A soaking-wet Oppa crawled back up.
chapters/ch2.27:
Babe… thank you.
I really thought I was gonna die….
chapters/ch2.29:
But… time's almost up and I barely caught anything…
Should we extend?
chapters/ch2.31: Heesu's Menhera gauge went past the limit…
chapters/ch2.32: …You pick our next date. Whatever you want.
chapters/ch2.62: I'll swallow you, seawater and all! Shhhhp~~!
chapters/ch2.66: This trophy pond is MY turf!
chapters/ch2.67: You dare cast a line in MY sea?!
chapters/ch2.70: Bought to land trophy fish. Today it lands monsters
chapters/ch2.72: Twelve pockets. One holds Oppa's snacks
chapters/ch2.78: The box he swore was "all essential"
chapters/ch2.80: Floats even in water. Bori's favorite orange
chapters/ch2.82: So shiny even the grouper fell for it. Hook removed
chapters/ch2.97:
Oppas rescued: 1
{lv}

Heesu picks the next date!
To be continued in Ch.3…
